content:
🎉 Thrilled to share that I've officially joined the CDS Hooks Project Management Committee! 🚀

After working with the CDS Hooks standard since 2017, I'm excited to take on this new role and help drive the standard forward. CDS Hooks has immense potential to revolutionize clinical decision support, and I'm eager to collaborate with the community to make it even more impactful.

If you're already using CDS Hooks, please add your implementation to our growing list: [CDS Hooks Availability](https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability). Your contributions will help others see the standard in action and foster a stronger ecosystem.

Not using CDS Hooks yet? I'm here to help! As a freelance consultant, I can assist you in implementing this powerful standard to enhance your clinical decision support capabilities. Let's connect and make something great happen! 🌟

#CDSHooks #HealthIT #ClinicalDecisionSupport #HealthcareInnovation #ProjectManagement #FreelanceConsultant
